# Built-in workflow reference

<!-- Generated by `make reference` from plugins/maister/skills/workflow-engine/workflows/*.yml. Do not edit by hand. -->

For people who write an overlay of a built-in workflow, or a workflow of their own that starts one. It lists, for each built-in, the inputs it takes, every step and checkpoint in the order a run meets them, what each checkpoint can answer and what each step declares it produces.

The ids in these tables are what an overlay names: `needs` and `before` of a step you add, `disable` and `tune` of a step that is there. A **checkpoint** is a gate the run stops at for your answer. **Runs when** is the step's guard: a step whose guard is false is skipped, and a skipped step still lets the steps after it run. A guard reads an input (`${inputs.<name>}`) or a value an earlier step or checkpoint recorded (`${<id>.values.<name>}`). [Extending Maister](extending.md) explains overlays and the grammar; `/maister:workflow-author nodes <workflow>` lists what an overlay can attach to in your own project.

- [`development`](#development)
- [`research`](#research)
- [`performance`](#performance)
- [`migration`](#migration)
- [`product-design`](#product-design)
- [`mockup-studio`](#mockup-studio)

## development

Builds a change to the code — a new feature, an enhancement, a bug fix or a refactor — from analysis through specification, planning, implementation and verification, with an operator gate after each phase. Use it for any task that modifies code; the optional stretches (a failing test written before the fix, UI mockups, a specification audit, browser checks, user documentation) run only when the task calls for them.

Started with `/maister:development`. Definition: `plugins/maister/skills/workflow-engine/workflows/development.yml`.

### Inputs

| Input | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_description` | string | yes |  |
| `research` | path | no |  |
| `context` | path | no |  |
| `design` | path | no |  |
| `architecture` | path | no |  |
| `audit` | string | no |  |
| `browser_tests` | string | no |  |
| `user_docs` | string | no |  |
| `sequential` | bool | no | `false` |
| `publish` | bool | no | `false` |

### Steps and checkpoints

| # | Id | Title | Kind | Runs | Needs | Runs when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `intake` | Intake | step | `direct:intake` |  | always |
| 2 | `codebase-analysis` | Codebase analysis | step | `skill:codebase-analyzer` | `intake` | always |
| 3 | `gap-analysis` | Gap analysis | step | `agent:gap-analyzer` | `codebase-analysis` | always |
| 4 | `gap-approval` | Approve gap analysis | checkpoint |  | `gap-analysis` | always |
| 5 | `tdd-red` | Failing test | step | `direct:tdd-red` | `gap-approval` | `${gap-analysis.values.has_reproducible_defect}` |
| 6 | `tdd-red-approval` | Approve the failing test | checkpoint |  | `tdd-red` | `${gap-analysis.values.has_reproducible_defect}` |
| 7 | `ui-mockups` | UI mockups | step | `skill:mockup-studio` | `tdd-red-approval` | `${gap-analysis.values.mockups_needed}` |
| 8 | `mockup-approval` | Approve UI mockups | checkpoint |  | `ui-mockups` | `${gap-analysis.values.mockups_needed}` |
| 9 | `specification` | Specification | step | `direct:specification` | `mockup-approval` | always |
| 10 | `specification-approval` | Approve specification | checkpoint |  | `specification` | always |
| 11 | `spec-audit` | Specification audit | step | `agent:spec-auditor` | `specification-approval` | `${specification-approval.values.spec_audit_enabled}` |
| 12 | `spec-audit-approval` | Approve specification audit | checkpoint |  | `spec-audit` | `${specification-approval.values.spec_audit_enabled}` |
| 13 | `planning` | Implementation planning | step | `agent:implementation-planner` | `spec-audit-approval` | always |
| 14 | `planning-approval` | Approve implementation plan | checkpoint |  | `planning` | `!${inputs.publish}` |
| 15 | `planning-approval-publish` | Approve implementation plan and publish | checkpoint |  | `planning-approval` | `${inputs.publish}` |
| 16 | `implementation` | Implementation | step | `skill:implementation-plan-executor` | `planning-approval-publish` | always |
| 17 | `implementation-approval` | Approve implementation | checkpoint |  | `implementation` | always |
| 18 | `tdd-green` | Passing test | step | `direct:tdd-green` | `implementation-approval` | `${gap-analysis.values.has_reproducible_defect}` |
| 19 | `verification-options` | Choosing the checks | step | `direct:verification-options` | `tdd-green` | always |
| 20 | `verification` | Verification | step | `skill:implementation-verifier` | `verification-options` | always |
| 21 | `verification-approval` | Approve verification | checkpoint |  | `verification` | always |
| 22 | `e2e-verification` | Browser checks | step | `agent:e2e-test-verifier` | `verification-approval` | `${verification-approval.values.browser_tests_enabled}` |
| 23 | `e2e-approval` | Approve browser checks | checkpoint |  | `e2e-verification` | `${verification-approval.values.browser_tests_enabled}` |
| 24 | `user-docs` | User documentation | step | `agent:user-docs-generator` | `e2e-approval` | `${verification-options.values.user_docs_enabled}` |
| 25 | `docs-approval` | Approve documentation | checkpoint |  | `user-docs` | `${verification-options.values.user_docs_enabled}` |
| 26 | `finalization` | Finalization | step | `direct:finalization` | `docs-approval` | always |

### Checkpoint answers

**`gap-approval`** asks: "Gap analysis complete. Continue?"

- `continue-past-analysis`: continue
- `revise-gap-analysis`: revise: sends the run back to `gap-analysis`
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`tdd-red-approval`** asks: "The failing test is written. Continue?"

- `continue-past-tdd-red`: continue
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`mockup-approval`** asks: "UI mockups complete. Continue to specification?"

- `continue-to-specification`: continue
- `revise-mockups`: revise: sends the run back to `ui-mockups`
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`specification-approval`** asks: "Specification complete. Continue?"

- `continue-to-planning`: continue; sets `spec_audit_enabled: false`
- `continue-to-spec-audit`: continue; sets `spec_audit_enabled: true`
- `revise-specification`: revise: sends the run back to `specification`
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`spec-audit-approval`** asks: "Specification audit complete. Continue to implementation planning?"

- `continue-to-planning`: continue
- `revise-specification`: revise: sends the run back to `specification`
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`planning-approval`** asks: "Implementation plan complete. Continue to implementation?"

- `continue-to-implementation`: continue
- `revise-plan`: revise: sends the run back to `planning`
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`planning-approval-publish`** asks: "Implementation plan complete. Continue to implementation, then push the branch and open a pull request?"

- `continue-to-implementation`: continue; grants `push`, `pr-create`
- `revise-plan`: revise: sends the run back to `planning`
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`implementation-approval`** asks: "Implementation complete. Continue?"

- `continue-past-implementation`: continue
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`verification-approval`** asks: "Verification complete. Continue?"

- `continue-past-verification`: continue; sets `browser_tests_enabled: false`
- `continue-to-browser-checks`: continue; sets `browser_tests_enabled: true`
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`e2e-approval`** asks: "E2E verification complete. Continue?"

- `continue-past-e2e`: continue
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

**`docs-approval`** asks: "Documentation complete. Continue to finalization?"

- `continue-to-finalization`: continue
- `stop-development`: stop: ends the run

| Step | Artifacts | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `intake` | `architecture_context`: `analysis/architecture-context`<br>`design_index`: `analysis/design-context/INDEX.md`<br>`research_context`: `analysis/research-context`<br>`work_context`: `analysis/work-context` |  |
| `codebase-analysis` | `analysis`: `analysis/codebase-analysis.md`<br>`clarifications`: `analysis/clarifications.md` |  |
| `gap-analysis` | `gap`: `analysis/gap-analysis.md`<br>`scope`: `analysis/scope-clarifications.md` | `has_reproducible_defect` (bool)<br>`mockups_needed` (bool)<br>`risk_level` (one of high, medium, low) |

## research

Answers a question by gathering evidence from the codebase, its documentation and the web, and synthesising it into a research report, optionally followed by solution brainstorming and a high-level design. Use it when the task is to investigate, compare options or decide an approach before any code is written, whether on its own or as a step inside another run.

Started with `/maister:research`. Definition: `plugins/maister/skills/workflow-engine/workflows/research.yml`.

### Inputs

| Input | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `question` | string | yes |  |
| `research_type` | string | no |  |
| `brainstorm` | string | no |  |
| `design` | string | no |  |
| `context` | path | no |  |
| `embedded` | bool | no | `false` |
| `findings_only` | bool | no | `false` |

### Steps and checkpoints

| # | Id | Title | Kind | Runs | Needs | Runs when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `research-foundation` | Research foundation | step | `direct:research-foundation` |  | always |
| 2 | `foundation-approval` | Approve the research foundation | checkpoint |  | `research-foundation` | `!${inputs.findings_only}` |
| 3 | `findings-approval` | Approve the research findings | checkpoint |  | `foundation-approval` | `${inputs.findings_only}` |
| 4 | `solution-generation` | Solution brainstorming | step | `agent:solution-brainstormer` | `findings-approval` | `${foundation-approval.values.brainstorming_enabled}` |
| 5 | `solution-convergence` | Solution convergence | step | `direct:solution-convergence` | `solution-generation` | `${foundation-approval.values.brainstorming_enabled}` |
| 6 | `convergence-approval` | Approve brainstorming | checkpoint |  | `solution-convergence` | `${foundation-approval.values.brainstorming_enabled}` |
| 7 | `high-level-design` | High-level design | step | `direct:high-level-design` | `convergence-approval` | `${foundation-approval.values.design_enabled} \|\| ${convergence-approval.values.design_enabled}` |
| 8 | `design-approval` | Approve design | checkpoint |  | `high-level-design` | `${foundation-approval.values.design_enabled} \|\| ${convergence-approval.values.design_enabled}` |
| 9 | `completion` | Final summary | step | `direct:completion` | `design-approval` | `!${inputs.embedded}` |

### Checkpoint answers

**`foundation-approval`** asks: "Research complete. Continue?"

- `continue-to-brainstorming`: continue; sets `brainstorming_enabled: true`, `design_enabled: false`
- `continue-to-design`: continue; sets `brainstorming_enabled: false`, `design_enabled: true`
- `finish-with-research`: continue; sets `brainstorming_enabled: false`, `design_enabled: false`
- `revise-research`: revise: sends the run back to `research-foundation`
- `stop-research`: stop: ends the run

**`findings-approval`** asks: "Research complete. Continue?"

- `continue-to-completion`: continue
- `revise-research`: revise: sends the run back to `research-foundation`
- `stop-research`: stop: ends the run

**`convergence-approval`** asks: "Brainstorming complete. Continue?"

- `continue-to-design`: continue; sets `design_enabled: true`
- `finish-without-design`: continue; sets `design_enabled: false`
- `revise-convergence`: revise: sends the run back to `solution-convergence`
- `stop-research`: stop: ends the run

**`design-approval`** asks: "High-level design complete. Continue?"

- `continue-to-completion`: continue
- `revise-design`: revise: sends the run back to `high-level-design`
- `stop-research`: stop: ends the run

### What each step declares

Artifact paths are relative to the run's task directory.

| Step | Artifacts | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `research-foundation` | `brief`: `planning/research-brief.md`<br>`explainer`: `outputs/research-explainer.html`<br>`findings`: `analysis/findings`<br>`plan`: `planning/research-plan.md`<br>`report`: `outputs/research-report.md`<br>`sources`: `planning/sources.md`<br>`synthesis`: `analysis/synthesis.md`<br>`work_context`: `analysis/work-context` | `conclusions` (string)<br>`confidence_level` (one of high, medium, low) |
| `solution-generation` | `decision_areas`: `outputs/decision-areas.json`<br>`exploration`: `outputs/solution-exploration.md` |  |
| `solution-convergence` |  | `selected_approach` (id) |
| `high-level-design` | `decision_log`: `outputs/decision-log.md`<br>`design`: `outputs/high-level-design.md` |  |

### What a run hands back

What a parent run, or a workflow that starts this one, can read once it ends.

| Output | Kind | From |
|---|---|---|
| `explainer` | artifact | `research-foundation.artifacts.explainer` |
| `research_report` | artifact | `research-foundation.artifacts.report` |
| `report` | artifact | `research-foundation.artifacts.report` |
| `findings_directory` | artifact | `research-foundation.artifacts.findings` |
| `solution_exploration` | artifact | `solution-generation.artifacts.exploration` |
| `high_level_design` | artifact | `high-level-design.artifacts.design` |
| `decision_log` | artifact | `high-level-design.artifacts.decision_log` |
| `conclusions` | value | `research-foundation.values.conclusions` |

## performance

Finds and fixes performance problems by static analysis of the code — N+1 queries, missing indexes, quadratic algorithms, blocking I/O, memory leaks — informed by profiling data when the operator supplies it, then specifies, plans, implements and verifies the optimisation. Use it when the task is to make something faster or leaner rather than to change what it does.

Started with `/maister:performance`. Definition: `plugins/maister/skills/workflow-engine/workflows/performance.yml`.

### Inputs

| Input | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_description` | string | yes |  |
| `sequential` | bool | no | `false` |

### Steps and checkpoints

| # | Id | Title | Kind | Runs | Needs | Runs when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `intake` | Intake | step | `direct:intake` |  | always |
| 2 | `codebase-analysis` | Codebase analysis | step | `skill:codebase-analyzer` | `intake` | always |
| 3 | `bottleneck-analysis` | Bottleneck analysis | step | `agent:bottleneck-analyzer` | `codebase-analysis` | always |
| 4 | `bottleneck-approval` | Approve bottleneck analysis | checkpoint |  | `bottleneck-analysis` | always |
| 5 | `specification` | Specification | step | `direct:specification` | `bottleneck-approval` | always |
| 6 | `specification-approval` | Approve specification | checkpoint |  | `specification` | always |
| 7 | `spec-audit` | Specification audit | step | `agent:spec-auditor` | `specification-approval` | always |
| 8 | `spec-audit-approval` | Approve specification audit | checkpoint |  | `spec-audit` | always |
| 9 | `planning` | Implementation planning | step | `agent:implementation-planner` | `spec-audit-approval` | always |
| 10 | `planning-approval` | Approve implementation plan | checkpoint |  | `planning` | always |
| 11 | `implementation` | Implementation | step | `skill:implementation-plan-executor` | `planning-approval` | always |
| 12 | `implementation-approval` | Approve implementation | checkpoint |  | `implementation` | always |
| 13 | `verification-options` | Choosing the checks | step | `direct:verification-options` | `implementation-approval` | always |
| 14 | `verification` | Verification | step | `skill:implementation-verifier` | `verification-options` | always |
| 15 | `verification-approval` | Approve verification | checkpoint |  | `verification` | always |
| 16 | `finalization` | Finalization | step | `direct:finalization` | `verification-approval` | always |

### Checkpoint answers

**`bottleneck-approval`** asks: "Performance analysis complete. Continue to specification?"

- `continue-to-specification`: continue
- `revise-analysis`: revise: sends the run back to `bottleneck-analysis`
- `stop-performance`: stop: ends the run

**`specification-approval`** asks: "Specification complete. Continue to specification audit?"

- `revise-specification`: revise: sends the run back to `specification`
- `stop-performance`: stop: ends the run

**`spec-audit-approval`** asks: "Specification audit complete. Continue to implementation planning?"

- `continue-to-planning`: continue
- `revise-specification`: revise: sends the run back to `specification`
- `stop-performance`: stop: ends the run

**`planning-approval`** asks: "Implementation plan complete. Continue to implementation?"

- `continue-to-implementation`: continue
- `revise-plan`: revise: sends the run back to `planning`
- `stop-performance`: stop: ends the run

**`implementation-approval`** asks: "Implementation complete. Continue to verification options?"

- `continue-to-verification-options`: continue
- `stop-performance`: stop: ends the run

**`verification-approval`** asks: "Verification complete. Continue to finalization?"

- `continue-to-finalization`: continue
- `stop-performance`: stop: ends the run

## migration

Moves code from one technology, platform or architecture pattern to another: it analyses the current state, plans an incremental migration with a rollback path, implements it and verifies compatibility. Use it for a framework or library upgrade, a platform change, a data or schema migration, or a move to a new architectural pattern.

Started with `/maister:migration`. Definition: `plugins/maister/skills/workflow-engine/workflows/migration.yml`.

### Inputs

| Input | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_description` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string | no |  |
| `user_docs` | bool | no | `false` |
| `sequential` | bool | no | `false` |

### Steps and checkpoints

| # | Id | Title | Kind | Runs | Needs | Runs when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `intake` | Intake | step | `direct:intake` |  | always |

| 4 | `gap-approval` | Approve gap analysis | checkpoint |  | `gap-analysis` | always |
| 5 | `specification` | Specification | step | `direct:specification` | `gap-approval` | always |
| 6 | `specification-approval` | Approve specification | checkpoint |  | `specification` | always |
| 7 | `planning` | Migration planning | step | `agent:implementation-planner` | `specification-approval` | always |
| 8 | `planning-approval` | Approve migration plan | checkpoint |  | `planning` | always |
| 9 | `execution` | Migration execution | step | `skill:implementation-plan-executor` | `planning-approval` | always |
| 10 | `execution-approval` | Approve migration execution | checkpoint |  | `execution` | always |
| 11 | `verification` | Verification | step | `skill:implementation-verifier` | `execution-approval` | always |

## product-design

Turns a fuzzy product or feature idea into a brief to build from: it explores the project, proposes the scope, decides each choice with sketches, and writes a brief with the final screens for the development workflow. Use it to decide what to build before building it.

Started with `/maister:product-design`. Definition: `plugins/maister/skills/workflow-engine/workflows/product-design.yml`.

### Inputs

| Input | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_description` | string | yes |  |
| `research` | path | no |  |
| `context` | path | no |  |
| `specification` | bool | no | `false` |
| `embedded` | bool | no | `false` |

### Steps and checkpoints

| # | Id | Title | Kind | Runs | Needs | Runs when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `intake` | Explore and propose the scope | step | `direct:intake` |  | always |
| 2 | `problem` | Problem and personas | step | `direct:problem` | `intake` | always |
| 3 | `problem-approval` | Approve the problem and choose the outcome | checkpoint |  | `intake`, `problem` | always |
| 4 | `alternatives` | Brainstorm alternatives | step | `agent:solution-brainstormer` | `problem-approval` | always |
| 5 | `sketches` | Sketches | step | `skill:mockup-studio` | `alternatives` | `${intake.values.draws} && ${alternatives.values.visual_areas}` |
| 6 | `convergence` | Converge on a direction | step | `direct:convergence` | `alternatives`, `sketches` | always |
| 7 | `direction-approval` | Approve the design direction | checkpoint |  | `convergence` | always |
| 8 | `specification` | Feature specification | step | `direct:specification` | `direction-approval` | `${inputs.specification} \|\| ${problem-approval.values.with_spec}` |
| 9 | `screens` | Final screens | step | `skill:mockup-studio` | `specification` | `${intake.values.draws}` |
| 10 | `brief` | Product brief and delivery scope | step | `direct:brief` | `screens` | always |
| 11 | `brief-approval` | Approve the brief and the screens | checkpoint |  | `brief`, `screens` | always |
| 12 | `completion` | Completion | step | `direct:completion` | `brief-approval` | `!${inputs.embedded}` |

### Checkpoint answers

**`problem-approval`** asks: "The scope proposal, the problem and the personas are ready. Which outcome should this run produce?"

- `brief-with-screens`: continue; sets `with_spec: false`
- `brief-with-spec`: continue; sets `with_spec: true`
- `correct-scope`: revise: sends the run back to `intake`
- `revise-problem`: revise: sends the run back to `problem`
- `use-quick-design`: stop: ends the run

**`direction-approval`** asks: "Design direction ready. Continue?"

- `approve-direction`: continue
- `revise-direction`: revise: sends the run back to `convergence`
- `stop-design`: stop: ends the run

**`brief-approval`** asks: "The brief and the screens are ready. Continue?"

- `approve-brief`: continue
- `change-brief`: revise: sends the run back to `brief`
- `change-screens-and-brief`: revise: sends the run back to `specification`
- `stop-design`: stop: ends the run

### What each step declares

Artifact paths are relative to the run's task directory.

| Step | Artifacts | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `intake` | `explore`: `analysis/explore`<br>`research_context`: `context/research-context`<br>`scope`: `analysis/scope.md`<br>`work_context`: `analysis/work-context` | `draws` (bool) |
| `problem` | `personas`: `analysis/personas.md`<br>`problem_statement`: `analysis/problem-statement.md` |  |
| `alternatives` | `alternatives`: `analysis/alternatives.md`<br>`decision_areas`: `analysis/decision-areas.json` | `visual_areas` (bool) |
| `sketches` | `mockups`: `analysis/mockups` |  |
| `convergence` | `decisions`: `analysis/design-decisions.md` |  |
| `specification` | `spec`: `analysis/feature-spec.md` |  |
| `screens` | `mockups`: `analysis/mockups` |  |
| `brief` | `brief`: `outputs/product-brief.md`<br>`delivery_scope`: `outputs/delivery-scope.yml` |  |

### What a run hands back

What a parent run, or a workflow that starts this one, can read once it ends.

| Output | Kind | From |
|---|---|---|
| `brief` | artifact | `brief.artifacts.brief` |
| `delivery_scope` | artifact | `brief.artifacts.delivery_scope` |
| `mockups` | artifact | `screens.artifacts.mockups` |

## mockup-studio

Draws one new version of a set of UI mockups from a note, under a folder it is given, and asks nothing; run it again with the same folder for the next version.

Started with `/maister:mockup-studio`. Definition: `plugins/maister/skills/workflow-engine/workflows/mockup-studio.yml`.

### Inputs

| Input | Type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_path` | path | no |  |
| `output_subdir` | string | no | `analysis/mockups` |
| `note` | string | yes |  |
| `against` | string | no |  |
| `scope` | string | no |  |
| `fidelity` | string | no | `sketch` |
| `format` | string | no |  |
| `brief` | string | no |  |
| `grounding` | path | no | `.maister/docs/design-context` |

### Steps and checkpoints

| # | Id | Title | Kind | Runs | Needs | Runs when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `turn` | Mockup turn | step | `skill:mockup-studio` |  | always |

### What each step declares

Artifact paths are relative to the run's task directory.

| `turn` | `turn_result`: `turn-result.json` | `against` (id)<br>`changed` (id)<br>`degraded` (bool)<br>`fidelity` (one of sketch, prototype)<br>`format` (one of html, ascii, scope)<br>`notes_count` (id)<br>`screens` (id)<br>`version` (id) |

| `changed` | value | `turn.values.changed` |

| `notes_count` | value | `turn.values.notes_count` |
| `format` | value | `turn.values.format` |
| `fidelity` | value | `turn.values.fidelity` |
